note: Ready-made Builder specs that combine price rules with SenIQ signals. Templates to backtest, not recommendations. Each spec must pass the engine's validate_spec.

presets.name: Trend with positive sentiment
presets.description: Buys an EMA 20/50 upward cross only while news sentiment is above the stock's own 90-day norm. Exits on the downward cross or an 8% stop.
presets.data_depth: Experimental. Sentiment history only goes back as far as SenIQ has been recording, so most backtest bars have no reading and the gate stays shut on them.

presets.name: Congress cluster buying
presets.description: Buys when at least two different members of Congress have disclosed buys in the last 45 days and the price is above its 50-day average. Exits below the average or on a 10% stop.
presets.data_depth: Thin. Uses disclosure dates, which lag the trades by up to 45 days. Loaded congress data covers 2026 only, a few trades per stock.

presets.name: Follow a politician
presets.description: Buys when the member you name discloses a buy of this stock, and exits when they disclose a sale, on a 20% gain or a 10% loss.
presets.data_depth: Thin. One person's disclosures in one stock are rare; expect very few trades. Disclosure dates lag the actual trades by up to 45 days.

presets.name: Fund accumulation trend
presets.description: Buys while at least three tracked funds hold the stock, more of them added than cut in their latest filings, and the 20-day EMA is above the 50-day. Exits when cuts outnumber adds, the trend turns, or on a 10% stop.
presets.data_depth: About a year. Ten tracked funds, quarterly 13F filings published up to 45 days after quarter end, so this signal moves at most four times a year. US stocks only.
